scientific_integrity: All-dimensional sign statements have an analytic proof; finite numerical and integer checks are supplementary rather than infinite certificates. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficients; p strictly between zero and two. Exact quadrature nodes are constrained to original Boolean sign outcomes. Approximate discretization and complex coefficients are not covered. Earlier cosine-transform injectivity may cover the exact-weight corollary; full signed inertia priority remains subject to independent literature inspection.
title: Strict Walsh inertia of Rademacher \(p\)-moment kernels and exact sampling rigidity
